prompt_en: Image 1 is the generated stage portrait used as the edit target. Image 2 supplies the original visible facial appearance, short bob and fringe reference. Preserve the same facial features, dark bob, wispy fringe, outfit, sparse flowering branch and quiet expression while clarifying the local shutter connection and source-bound face illumination. A photorealistic gothic romantic photograph, combining ornate dark textures with pale blossoms and warm gold illumination, presents a person whose facial appearance and hair draw from the supplied photograph in a coherent complex scene. The atmosphere is serene, still, ethereal and quietly melancholic. She is a fictional adult stage technician in an empty chamber rehearsal room, pausing after a small adjustment to an old scenic shutter beside a compact organ. Her dark jaw-length bob has softly separated wispy bangs; brown eyes, a gently rounded facial outline, a small straight nose and natural soft pink lips retain the visible reference cues. A high-collared black lace blouse with botanical embroidery follows her relaxed shoulders; its long sleeves crease naturally at the elbows. Her right hand keeps its existing grip on the same black velvet pull cord beside her torso, with the elbow comfortably bent. Above her right hand, the same black pull cord climbs in an unobstructed vertical line to a small brass pulley on the fixed top rail. Its continuous strand wraps visibly over the pulley, then runs in a short diagonal segment to a tight knot through a clearly visible mounting hole in the upper inner edge of the movable gilt shutter leaf. The pulley groove, diagonal rope segment, terminal knot and shutter-leaf hinge occupy clear space below the top rail and beside the sparse flowering branch. Tension from her grip pulls that leaf a few degrees away from its stationary companion, maintaining the same thin vertical seam of warm golden light behind her shoulder. One continuous, mostly leafless brown branch is anchored to the shutter's upper frame, bearing small ivory flowers at distinct nodes with bare woody intervals between them; this sparse contour lets the golden seam remain visible. A companion flowering twig occupies the farther side, and a delicate branch shadow falls across the adjacent charcoal wall. She keeps the adjusted shutter open at the same useful width, with her current quiet off-camera glance and softly parted lips retained, the left hand resting open on the edge of the organ bench. Her stance is upright and easy. The organ pipes and worn bench establish the rehearsal space while staying subordinate to her attentive presence. Her face is the first focal point, the holding hand and line of light the second, and the pale blossoms and dark carved surface the third. A chest-height capture camera stays at the same gentle front three-quarter direction and steps back slightly in a vertical medium portrait, including both hands, the organ bench edge and the entire shutter mechanism from fixed top rail to leaf attachment. The upper framing leaves clear space around the complete pulley and the short attachment segment. A natural 50mm perspective and moderate depth of field keep the connected mechanism readable. The light grazes her bob and lace, with broad soft frontal fill retaining natural skin texture. Soft neutral-cool frontal fill keeps the central forehead, nose and cheeks pale with a distinctly cool pink-gray cast. The warm gold source travels through the same slit, strikes the nearby gilt inner edge, and rebounds onto a thin strip of her seam-facing temple, cheek rim and jaw contour. This amber skin rim is clearly visible on actual skin, separate from the stronger gold line on her hair; the forehead, nose and central cheeks retain their cooler tone. Antique gold, ivory and charcoal sit in a muted low-contrast grade with lifted matte blacks, soft ivory highlight roll-off and fine film grain; photorealistic fine-art photography.
